cells.nuance: Positions range from monist to theist across the streams.
Vegetarian practice is common though not universal.
Temple priesthood, largely hereditary, runs parallel to renunciant orders and the guru-disciple line.

cells.label: Traditionally non-missionary
cells.nuance: Historically birth-based; several modern movements accept and some actively seek converts.
Endless cycles of manifestation and dissolution across vast kalpas; multiple creation accounts are held together without contradiction.
Regional custom and ritual-purity dress in temple contexts; ascetics are marked apart.
Duty relative to station and stage of life, with ahimsa and hospitality broadly held.
Knowledge, devotion, action, and discipline are recognized margas to moksha; schools rank them differently.
The Vedas are nominally supreme; in practice the epics, Puranas, and teachers' lineages carry living authority.
Truth is one and the wise call it by many names is a commonly held frame; schools still rank paths internally.

cells.label: Puja, home and temple
cells.nuance: Household puja, temple darshan, and the festival calendar; no fixed congregational day.
